paragraphs: A paper-review management system for NICOM, the annual national conference hosted by the Institute of Management, Nirma University.
Authors submit through a Google Form. Responses land in a Google Sheet, with papers stored in Google Drive. The portal sits on top of that Sheet:
Policies built in: double-blind review · two reviewers per paper · decision emails written in the portal and sent by a committee member from their own mailbox.
features: Admins (conference committee) distribute papers to faculty by track, track progress, finalise decisions and copy the drafted author emails.
Faculty reviewers see only the papers assigned to them, open each paper from Drive, score it and submit a recommendation.
Overview dashboard: submissions, papers still needing reviewers, reviews done/pending/overdue, decisions, emails sent, a pipeline per track, faculty progress, and a "needs your attention" list.

Auto-distribution: each paper gets 2 reviewers from faculty mapped to its track (least-loaded first, respecting each person's max papers). Preview first, then confirm. Papers that can't be staffed are flagged with the…
Manual assignment per paper, due-date changes, reviewer removal.

requirements.text: Accounts: add reviewers or admins with a login ID and password, map tracks, set max papers, reset passwords, deactivate (takes effect immediately).
